notes: Provisional, recalibrated after D-052 (doc 07 s4.1 steps 1 to 4, spike 14). Method unchanged: 30 probes (18 answerable, 5 not_in_docs, 7 off_topic) run through the real search code with calibration=true on the 81-chunk corpus (text-embedding-3-small, k=5, top cosine among the returned chunks; script services/knowledge/scripts/probe_retrieval.py, one embedding request). The set holds the 20 generic probes plus the S1 to S5 customer questions (L1 s4, Loom order) with their personas' tiers. Focused, question-shaped sections were added to the refund-policy, support-and-escalation, roles-and-permissions and billing-invoices-payments articles (data/articles and Notion together). Because tau_high is a quartile, improving content raises it, so about a quarter of probes stay weak by construction (D-052). corpus_version is the ingest run's value, also read from the database by the probe script.
